retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s new wave aesthetic featuring a group of stylized figures in oversized, patterned blazers against a soft blue-to-purple gradient with neon-accented wide-set typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: Four male figures with voluminous 80s hairstyles stand in a row against a studio gradient. They wear high-contrast, patterned blazers with exaggerated shoulder pads and pleated trousers. The lighting is flat and soft, typical of mid-80s studio portraiture, with a vibrant neon title spanning the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal alignment of figures across the lower two-thirds
Contrast between vibrant patterned jackets and dark trousers
Typography anchored to the top margin with extreme letter spacing
Color harmony between the background gradient and the cool-toned clothing
coreInvariants: Exaggerated shoulder pads on all jackets
Voluminous, feathered blonde or light-brown hairstyles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body group portrait occupying the lower 75% of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the bright blue patterned suit acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the neon pink title at the top, move down to the faces of the band members, and scan across their varied fashion choices.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper third of the frame to accommodate the title and subtitle.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blue and lavender gradient background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark navy trousers providing a heavy base
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink and electric blue in the typography and jackets
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the accents against a medium-value, soft-focus background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary, much smaller sans-serif in white with even wider tracking placed directly below the main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and width

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four men with 80s mullets wearing oversized patterned blazers (blue, white/black, black/gold) against a blue-to-purple gradient background. Leave the top 25% of the image as empty gradient space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in neon pink 'Microgramma Bold Extended' with extreme tracking across the top. Add a subtitle in small white sans-serif with even wider tracking centered below it.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the title extremely wide?
Are the shoulder pads on the jackets visibly oversized?
Is the background a smooth vertical gradient?
Is the title color a vibrant neon pink?

postGenerationChecks: Verify typography is centered and wide-set
Ensure the gradient is smooth without banding
Confirm the color palette is cohesive
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Studio Portrait + Oversized Patterned Blazers + Neon Geometric Sans (Wide Tracking) + Blue/Purple Gradient
